meta_title: Hemi-Sync Romania — Exploring consciousness through sound
meta_description: Monroe Institute® programmes in Romania: Gateway Voyage®, SyncCreation®, Lucid Dreaming®, free Hemi-Sync® exercises and the Focus levels.
hero_lead: For over 50 years, Hemi-Sync® audio technology has guided explorers of consciousness towards expanded states — without dogma, at your own pace.
hero_card_text: The foundational programme for exploring consciousness.
gateway_text: The foundational programme for exploring consciousness.
synccreation_text: Become a conscious co-creator of your life.
exercises_lead: Hemi-Sync® audio exercises, to listen to right here, free of charge.
exercises_headphones: Listen with headphones, in a comfortable position and a quiet place where you won't be disturbed.
ex_intro_text: Get to know Hemi-Sync® audio technology: a quieter mind and a relaxed body.
ex_dec_text: The introductory exercise of the Dolphin Energy Club, created within the Monroe Institute.
ex_forgiveness_text: A meditation the Monroe Institute offers to everyone who carries painful memories.
ex_season_text: A short journey to your loved ones and to the Earth seen from above, under snow.
tech_text: Hemi-Sync® sends precise, slightly different sounds to each ear. The brain responds by synchronising the activity of its two hemispheres, supporting states of deep relaxation, clarity and inner exploration.
tech_diagram_label: How it works: one frequency in each ear, a third one perceived
tech_headphones: Listen with headphones. These are low tones — laptop speakers barely play them, and the binaural effect does not appear at all.
method_text_1: Hemi-Sync® asks you to believe nothing. It offers
method_text_2: — audio technologies that support you in exploring your own consciousness, with full respect for your free will.
focus_lead: The Focus levels are names for states of consciousness you explore gradually, guided by sound. They are landmarks of your experience, not steps to climb.
focus_10_text: The first threshold: the body fully relaxed while the mind stays lucid and alert.
focus_12_text: Attention widens beyond ordinary perception: room for intuition, visualisation and clarity.
focus_15_text: The usual sense of linear time fades; a deep stillness remains.
focus_21_text: The body reaches a very deep relaxation while awareness stays awake and able to explore.
focus_note: Descriptions of what listeners experience, not claims about reality.
club_text: The Dolphin Energy Club brings together listeners who practise the DEC exercise together, created within the Monroe Institute. You can begin with the free introductory exercise.
club_note: The club is complementary and does not replace medical or psychological treatment.
guide_lead: The guide answers from the programme pages and shows its sources. For anything else, a person from the team writes back.
ask_suggest_1: Which programme should I start with?
guide_intro: Welcome. I'm the Hemi-Sync guide. I'll help you choose a programme or an exercise, and show you where my answer comes from.
guide_footer: Answered from reviewed Hemi-Sync pages. It does not replace medical or psychological treatment.
guide_refusal_crisis: If you or someone near you is in danger, call 112 now.
guide_refusal_out_of_scope: I can't answer questions about diagnosis, medication or treatment. Hemi-Sync® programmes are an exploration and do not replace treatment: for that, talk to a doctor or a psychologist.
guide_refusal_no_content: I don't have a checked answer to that yet. The programme pages are a lovely place to start.
guide_refusal_unavailable: I can't answer just now. Come back in a little while, or start from the programme pages meanwhile.

hq_start_a: With the free exercises, listened to with headphones. If you want to go further, Gateway Voyage® is the foundational programme for exploring consciousness.
hq_belief_q: Do I need to believe anything in particular?
hq_belief_a: No. Hemi-Sync® asks you to believe nothing: it offers direct experience, with full respect for your free will.
hq_language_q: What language are the programmes in?
hq_language_a: Romanian. They are official Monroe Institute programmes, facilitated by accredited trainers.
hq_request_q: Does registering mean I have a place booked?
hq_venue_q: Where do the residential programmes take place?
hq_venue_a: The place of each edition is listed with the scheduled sessions. The residential programmes on the current site take place at Plaiul Foii.
hq_ladder_q: Are the Focus levels steps to climb?
hq_ladder_a: No. They are names for states of consciousness, landmarks of your experience, not a hierarchy.
hq_therapy_a: No. Hemi-Sync® programmes are an exploration and do not replace medical or psychological treatment. For diagnosis or treatment, talk to a doctor or a psychologist.

account_nav_hint: One account for every Psi site: sign in once, sign out everywhere.
account_lead: One account for Hemi-Sync, Psizone, EQ-SYNC and the blog. Sign in once and every site knows you.
account_signed_out_lead: Sign in with your Psi account. Our sites never ask for or keep a password: you sign in once, with Psi.
account_unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now.
account_privacy_note: We keep only what you chose: no clinical record, no diagnosis. You can ask for an export or for your account to be erased at any time.
account_site_note: Your session requests and your access to the free exercises will appear here.
account_unavailable_lead: We cannot check access right now. Nothing is lost; please try again in a few minutes.

account_profile_lead: Only what we need to reach you. We fill them into forms for you, and you can change them any time.
account_profile_name: The name you'd like us to use
account_profile_email_note: This comes from your Psi account; change it there.
account_profile_contact: How you'd like us to reach you
account_profile_language: The language we write to you in
account_profile_invalid: Something doesn't fit: check the phone number (we need it if you'd like a call).
account_consents_lead: Each consent stands on its own and you can withdraw it any time. When you do, we delete what we kept for it, straight away.
account_purpose_guide_memory_title: Remember my conversations with the guide
account_purpose_guide_memory_text: The guide remembers what you talked about, so you don't start over. You can read and delete them under Conversations. It is not a clinical record.
account_purpose_booking_contact_text: We may contact you about your booking requests the way you prefer.
account_purpose_programme_progress_text: The days you've done and your protocols, so you carry on where you left off.
account_bookings_lead: The requests you made while signed in. You can cancel the upcoming ones.
account_bookings_empty: You have no booking requests in your account yet.
account_bookings_off: Appointments are booked on Psizone; you'll find them in your account there.
account_bookings_link_lead: We add it here if you have the reference and the cancel code you were given. Without both, nothing is tied to your account.
account_bookings_link_failed: We couldn't find a request with that reference and code.
account_bookings_linked: The request is now in your account.
account_conversations_lead: Only with your consent. What you delete here is gone for good.
account_conversations_off: Right now we keep nothing you ask. If you'd like the guide to remember, give your consent.
account_conversations_empty: No conversation kept yet. Ask the guide something and you'll find it here.
account_data_lead: Everything we keep about you, in plain view.
account_export_text: A JSON file with your profile, consents, appointments, saved articles and kept conversations.
account_erase_text: We erase your profile, consents, conversations and reading list on every Psi site, and sign you out everywhere. Booking requests stay with the clinic, no longer tied to you.
account_erase_mismatch: The word didn't match, so nothing was erased.
account_data_elsewhere: Everything in your account, appointments included, is kept together on Psizone. Download it or erase your account there, for every site at once.
account_data_elsewhere_button: Go to your data on Psizone
account_soon_text: We're preparing one account for Psizone, EQ-SYNC, Hemi-Sync and the blog. Until then, everything here works without one: you can read, ask the guide and request an appointment.
account_security_text: When you sign out, we sign you out of every Psi site at once: Psizone, EQ-SYNC, Hemi-Sync and the blog.
account_card_next_empty: No appointment coming up. Whenever you're ready, we'll find a time together.
account_card_book_elsewhere: Evaluations are booked on Psizone, with this same account.
account_card_saved_empty: Nothing saved yet. On the blog, choose “Save this article” in the compass.
account_card_memory_on: The guide remembers what you talked about. You can read and delete them any time.
account_card_memory_off: The guide keeps nothing you ask.
